name: reaction
title: Reaction
description: Emoji answers to a message, each with its count, that a press adds to.
use: The short answers readers leave under a message, a comment or a post: a thumbs up, a heart. Each reaction is a label around a native checkbox, so a press adds the reader's own and a second press takes it back; the count follows with no script.

instead.when: The reader moves one score up or down instead of choosing among emoji
The reader picks one answer to a question and sees how the votes fell
The pill filters a list instead of answering a message
The count only describes something and cannot be added to

keyboard.action: Adds or takes back the reader's reaction, as the native checkbox does
On reaction-add: opens the emoji picker, as a popover's button does

platform.feature: text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic on the count
platform.fallback: Flex centres the count's line instead of its figures, which then stand within half a pixel of the middle

classes.name: reaction-group
classes.description: The row of reactions, on an element with role="group" and a name. It wraps; under a message it stands where the bubble does, and in a thread under the words

classes.name: reaction
classes.description: One reaction: a 28px pill around a reaction-input, an emoji and a count. Set --count to the reactions of everyone but the reader

classes.name: reaction-input
classes.description: The checkbox that holds the reader's own reaction. It covers the pill invisibly; name it with the emoji and the others' count, such as "Thumbs up, 3 others"

classes.name: reaction-emoji
classes.description: The emoji: a character in a span, or a picture with the class on the img. Hide it from assistive technology when the input is named. Also the emoji of a picker's button

classes.name: reaction-count
classes.description: The count, written by the counter when the element is empty: --count, and one more while the reader's reaction is given. Text inside it, such as 1.2k, is shown instead

classes.name: reaction-add
classes.description: A round button at the end of the row, with a face and a plus, that opens the page's emoji picker; it stays sunk while a popover right after it is open

states.name: checked
states.description: The reader's reaction is given: an ink hairline, a faint tint of ink, the count in strong ink and one more

states.name: disabled
states.description: The pill takes disabled ink and stops answering the pointer

states.name: open
states.description: On a popover right after the button: the button stays sunk into a well

properties.name: --count
properties.description: How many others gave this reaction; the reader's own is added while the box is checked
